changes.reason: Keep the recalled insult consistent while retaining the distinct Ogrunti spelling.

preserved: Tanaka and Katana have separate names/greetings; Katana witnesses the brothers death rather than being silently substituted for Tanaka.
Insults expose the mistaken Ur-Quan identity; the register shifts from hostile declarations to respectful 하오체 after recognition.
Despair, refusal to leave the homeworld and renewed hope remain distinct responses; no branch outcomes are inferred from record names.
Six sisters, six-week-dead Dhrang, at least a hundred FunRom viewings, hundreds of ships, hours and less-than-half ship size retain their scope.
Beta Brahe device test, VUX limpets slowing travel and the Zeta Sextantis planet damaging sensors are separate events. Glory Device switch failure is not repaired in translation.
Reward-to-duty self-correction, gently waking the maidens and their explicit consent are preserved.
Name/alliance/flagship fragments retain order, source IDs and boundaries; static Tanaka goodbye remains the source text without guessing callback reachability.
Dgrunti in dialogue and Ogrunti in outtakes remain separate glossary spellings.
limitations: Agent semantic review is not user approval.
Dynamic name assembly, Tanaka/Katana game-state branches, subtitle timing, audio playback and glyph readability remain runtime checks.
